problem_type: Plan projections lose field ownership and misreport image consumption
symptom: Agent night prompt is replaced by dusk at generation; visual anchors appear used by text-only modes
direct_cause: syncShotNodeWithRow unconditionally writes prompt; rowConsumesReferences counts any slot
class_root: Missing shared per-field ownership and slot-derived image-consumption invariants
affected_population: All bound storyboard original nodes edited by Agent or user
All visual anchors referenced by modes without image input
internal_only_reason: Application ownership is determined by the approved plan B; no third-party behavior or protocol change is involved.
invariants: Marked fields read original-node values; unmarked fields read PlanShot; duration is never an override
Image consumption derives exclusively from slots using shared SLOT_ACCEPTS; warnings never reject user t2v choices
generality_proof: All canvas content write actions mark field ownership; projection writes preserve marks. All policy consumers use slot-derived capabilities across vendors.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own image consumption derived from slots
Classify explicit canvas field edits at the mutation boundary
